blocks.text: The production of plant 2 in November 2026 resulted in 18,400 pieces, surpassing the plan of 17,500.
The scrap rate decreased to 2.1 percent, a significant improvement from October's 2.9 percent.
A maintenance action is scheduled to replace the cutting tool on press 4 by December 12, 2026.
